purpose: Frozen ordered reserve holdout. Never used for prompt tuning or model calls during construction.

mechanismAliases: opens an Excel workbook session while requesting only Sites.ReadWrite.All
omits Files.ReadWrite from create_workbook even though it calls _create_excel_session
declares SharePoint site access but not the file scope required by the Graph workbook session endpoint
consequenceAliases: Microsoft Graph rejects workbook session creation after the file is uploaded
create_workbook cannot return a usable Excel session with its declared OAuth grant
SharePoint workbook creation fails at the session step despite successful site authorization

mechanismAliases: chains Ultracite after the icon generator even when it reports zero generated components
runs the formatter across the entire existing icon directory on every no-op prebuild
places formatting unconditionally in the package script instead of the generator's generated-path branch
consequenceAliases: a dashboard Docker build can fail in formatting even though no icon source changed
the design-system prebuild performs an unnecessary side effect on a no-op generation
building a consumer reruns formatting over all existing icons and can block the image build

mechanismAliases: unconditionally prevents the prompt action's mousedown default behavior
uses a mouse-specific focus-preservation handler that also cancels touch compatibility events
does not distinguish touch input before calling preventDefault on the action trigger
consequenceAliases: the prompt send button does not fire on mobile
touching a prompt action cancels the synthesized click needed by the control
mobile users cannot submit chat prompts with the action button

mechanismAliases: redirects /register to the account UI without appending location.searchStr
constructs the registration redirect from only the account base URL
ignores all incoming query parameters in the new Better-Auth registration route
consequenceAliases: organization invitation tokens are lost during registration
an invited user reaches generic signup instead of the invitation-aware flow
query-controlled registration context disappears at the dashboard redirect

mechanismAliases: captures every non-validation application error without checking for a client-aborted request
reports AbortError even when request.signal.aborted proves the requesting client disconnected
does not distinguish expected client cancellation from an unhandled server exception
consequenceAliases: normal browser navigation creates false Sentry errors
client disconnects pollute production error alerts
expected cancelled responses are counted as Experience API failures

mechanismAliases: defines Telegram output models with typing.TypedDict while supporting Python 3.10 and 3.11
uses the standard-library TypedDict variant that lacks Pydantic's required metadata before Python 3.12
omits the typing-extensions backport for typed outputs on the toolkit's supported interpreters
consequenceAliases: Pydantic cannot generate Telegram tool output schemas on Python 3.11
the worker fails to load or introspect Telegram typed outputs on supported Python versions
Telegram tools raise typed-dict-version before execution on Python below 3.12

mechanismAliases: reads record_id and values from Attio list entries instead of parent_record_id and entry_values
parses list-entry responses using the record-query field names
looks for list attributes under a response key the Attio API does not return
consequenceAliases: list-specific attributes silently disappear from get_list_entries output
the tool returns an empty record ID for valid Attio list entries
agents cannot see the stage or parent record attached to a list entry

mechanismAliases: always replaces browser history when asynchronous chat persistence completes
does not check whether the user left the chat route before applying the persisted chat URL
lets a delayed onChatPersisted callback overwrite newer navigation
consequenceAliases: a user who navigates to settings is unexpectedly dragged back into chat
late chat persistence overrides the route the user deliberately selected
background save completion hijacks browser navigation

mechanismAliases: defines the new shared-mailbox output contracts with typing.TypedDict on Python 3.11
uses the standard-library TypedDict variant that Pydantic cannot introspect before Python 3.12
omits the typing-extensions backport for the Outlook shared-mailbox output schema
consequenceAliases: Pydantic cannot construct the SearchEmailsResult schema on a supported interpreter
the worker fails while loading the new Outlook shared-mailbox tool outputs on Python 3.11
Outlook shared-mailbox output registration raises typed-dict-version before execution

mechanismAliases: assigns the root route as recovery for every route error, including an empty account already at root
renders Go Home actions for the no-organizations state even though the destination is the current page
does not distinguish an invalid route from the absence of any organization or project to enter
consequenceAliases: a user with no organizations gets recovery buttons that do nothing
the empty-account error screen offers a dead-end link back to itself
users are presented with apparent recovery actions that cannot change their state
